title: Consultation Response Template
primary_target: Commission consultation or Have Your Say portal
best_when: You are responding to an open public consultation and need a structured policy response.
not_for: One-to-one complaints; media outreach; ombudsman complaints.

title: Freedom of Information (FOI) Request Template
best_when: You need documents from an EU institution under Regulation 1049/2001.
not_for: National FOI systems; media pitches; political outreach.

title: European Ombudsman Complaint Template
best_when: You need to allege maladministration by an EU institution or body after direct contact failed.
not_for: National authorities; local ombudsmen; ordinary private-company disputes.

title: Platform Account Suspension Or Removal
best_when: An account or content restriction needs a first review request or statement-of-reasons follow-up.
not_for: Formal regulator-delay complaints; Parliament outreach.

title: Illegal Content Or Notice-And-Action Problem
best_when: You reported illegal content or a listing and need a clean platform follow-up.
not_for: General media outreach; national ombudsman complaints.

title: Dark Patterns And Manipulative Design
primary_target: Platform or trader compliance or support contact
best_when: You need a first complaint about manipulative interfaces or unfair flow design.
not_for: Formal DPA silence follow-up; journalist pitch.

title: Data Access, Deletion, Or Profiling Problem
best_when: A rights request or follow-up to a controller is the first procedural step.
not_for: DPA delay escalation; MEP oversight pressure.

title: AI Decision Harm Or Opaque Automated Output
best_when: You need an explanation or review request after an AI-assisted decision or opaque output.
not_for: Formal court filing; regulator-delay oversight letters.

title: Online Scam, Fake Seller, Or Marketplace Failure
primary_target: Marketplace or payment-platform support or complaints team
best_when: A marketplace failure or scam needs a clean first complaint to the platform.
not_for: Formal NGO coalition asks; ombudsman complaints.

title: Inaccessible Digital Service Or App
best_when: You need a first accessibility-failure report and practical remediation ask.
not_for: EU Ombudsman complaints against national bodies; journalist pitches.

title: Cross-Border Online Consumer Dispute
best_when: A trader or platform dispute crosses borders and needs a first documented complaint.
not_for: DPA-specific privacy complaints; Commission consultation responses.

title: MEP Outreach On A Policy File Or Procedural Concern
best_when: You want a citizen-facing procedural concern email to an MEP on a policy file.
not_for: Formal filings to regulators or ombudsmen.

title: Committee Coordinator Pressure Email
best_when: You want to pressure a committee coordinator on process; pace; or stakeholder balance.
not_for: Private controller complaints; first-contact support tickets.

title: Commission Consultation Process Challenge
primary_target: Commission service; cabinet; or Secretariat-General contact
best_when: A consultation process itself is the problem and you need to challenge timing; opacity; or imbalance.
not_for: Ordinary company complaints or DPA filings.

title: Journalist Issue Pitch
best_when: The issue has public-interest value and you need a short media pitch.
not_for: Private legal complaints or controller rights requests.

title: NGO Support Or Amplification Request
best_when: You want review; support; or amplification from an NGO or network.
not_for: First rights requests to companies or formal court filings.

title: DPA Follow-Up After Silence
best_when: A correctly filed GDPR complaint has gone quiet and you need a focused procedural follow-up.
not_for: Initial controller contact; journalist outreach before a complaint exists.

title: Privacy NGO Support Or Amplification Request
best_when: A GDPR issue looks systemic and you want strategic privacy-group support.
not_for: Basic personal rights requests without a systemic angle.

title: Journalist Pitch On GDPR Under-Enforcement
best_when: A GDPR problem has turned into a public-interest enforcement story.
not_for: Thinly evidenced personal disputes.

title: MEP Oversight Pressure On GDPR Under-Enforcement
best_when: A GDPR case now shows systemic regulator delay or under-enforcement and needs oversight pressure.
not_for: Initial controller contact or ordinary consumer complaint.

title: Cross-Border GDPR Complaint Coordination
best_when: Several complainants or organisations need a shared coordination note before wider escalation.
not_for: First-contact complaints to a controller or public journalist pitch.
